evidence: The switch (unk5) has no default; a streak only sets unk5 to 1 (case 0) and 2 (case 1), and case 2 ends the object, so no value outside 0-2 falls through.
The implicit default of switch (unk5): the ready line's own steps set unk5 only to 0-2, all named.
The implicit default of switch (unk5): the search light's main only ever sets unk5 to 0-3, all named cases.

search_light_shapes gives every light vertex 1 right of vertex 0 (by 0x80/0x50/0x10) and vertex 3 below it (0 vs -0x100/-0x50); the sweep moves vertices 0 and 1 together, so ABS never takes its negative side.

web_piece_quad_frames put vertex 1 at x 0x100..0x800 right of vertex 0 (x 0) in every frame and the scale is positive (0x100..0x500), so ABS(v1.x, v0.x) never takes its negative side.
